verdict.rationale: Render documents an 'Environment variables' feature. Its managed OIDC issues short-lived, auto-rotated identity tokens in place of stored API keys, which covers part of secrets handling. It also claims it can prevent non-production environments from reaching production services. Nothing in the pack shows team-level access control or a central, shared place to manage secrets and environment variables across services. Missing for 10: team/workspace role-based access control, centralized shared secret/env-var groups across services, detailed docs on env-var management, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can manage team-level access, secrets, and environment variables centrally

citations.quote: Render services can authenticate to both providers without storing long-lived API keys. Render instead issues short-lived identity tokens for each service and automatically rotates them as needed.
Prevent non-production environments from accessing production services.
